title.narrative: Women Voices on Free Maternity Policy

description.narrative:
Focusing on the women’s with disability representation gaps at the grassroots, our advocacy approach dubbed ENHANCING GRASSROOTS WOMEN’S PARTICIPATION AND LEADERSHIP IN ACTUALIZING FREE MATERNITY focuses on the free and affordable maternity (for young women within the child-bearing age) as envisaged in the Universal Health Coverage (UHC) policy and strategy that advocates for free maternity and total end to maternal deaths, but has not been very practical in Kisumu County as more young women particularlythose with disabilities, continues to die while giving birth. We propose to actively engage women with disability in Kisumu County Health (free maternity) Budget Policy formulation, implementation, monitoring and oversight to ensure full attainment of health rights and sufficient primary health care budget allocations. By this, we want to engage over 5000 grassroots young women particularly those with disability in advocacy, capacity-building, establishment of a strong and active platform for follow ups and oversight of the free and affordable maternity budgets and social audit of the implemented projects to cushion the young women from rampant maternal deaths and otherrelated problems associated with the risky Traditional Birth Attendants (TBAs) on maternity matters due to limitation in the affordable maternity services being offered at the moment in Kisumu County particularly at the grassroots.
The goal of this project is tocontribute to the active grassroots women’s participation and leadership inactualizing free and affordable maternity through participation in the Kisumu County Government Health Budgets formulation that favours free and affordable maternity as envisaged in the Universal Health Coverage policy and strategy.
The intended result include:- a) Enhanced grassroots women’s voices towards free and affordable maternity through a well catered for health budget that meets the demand of the primary health care among women and children in Kisumu County. b) A well women-involved healthbudget as a policy document that is reflective of the needs of the young women and children who are the majority in Kisumu County. c) Enhanced grassroots oversight platform on free and affordable maternity budgetfor women leadership, mobilization and participation for successful roll out of the free maternity at the grassroots.

participating-org.narrative:
Kisumo Grassroots Friends Self Help Group is young women led organization formed and registered in 2017 and works in Kisumu Centraland remote areas of Kisumu City in collaboration with key strategic partners. As a group, we remain strategic as we focus on key policy and advocacy projects that we aspire to undertake for the interest of women and young mothers with disabilities.
Our mission is to create a better environment for the rights of young women and youths with disability and especially those of the marginalized (young widows and single mothers). Our vision is an inclusive society that promotes equal access to and implementation of women and youth human rights. All women, both young and old, regardless of their origin, race, religion, marital status or ethnic group, shouldgrow up in a political, social and domestic environment that protects and promotes their rights and dignity.
We have a board made of 5 members (4 female and 1 male) that is responsible for decision making through oversightand guidance on the project and general day to day operation of the organization. In the board, the decision is either made through voting or consensus. The board gets a technical advice from the programmes coordinator who doubles up as the head of all the programmes. The programmes coordinator is supported by the coordinators who are in charge of the programmes in the field.
The Chairperson who is responsible for chairing the meetings and sessions for decision making is a woman, the Secretary who doubles up as the programmes coordinator is a woman in charge ofthe overall projects and programme works within the organization, the Treasurer who is responsible for funds withdrawals and reconciliation in the bank account is a young woman, the organising secretary responsible for the general membership is a woman
